scope: Recheck Command Code free-offer availability without changing pricing entries or benchmark identities.

checks.observation: Current available-model tables, documented as generated from the same registry as CLI --list-models and /model, do not list Beam or Crouton. The stealth section lists Glyph Cluster.
Beam and Crouton promotional sections are absent. Glyph remains a zero-credit preview with up to 1,000 requests/day while the preview lasts.
Opening the former Beam page resolves to the general catalog rather than a current Beam offer.
Opening the former Crouton page resolves to the general catalog rather than a current Crouton offer.
Historical CLI v1.85.0 notes announce Beam 1.0. CLI v1.88.4 explicitly retires the free Laguna S2.1 offering.

decision: Mark Beam and Crouton not-currently-listed, keep Glyph temporary-free, and mark the free Laguna offering retired. Preserve older evidence and all numeric pricing entries.
verificationLimits: Official public pages were checked on November 12, 2026; no authenticated API or live model invocation was performed. Search-index copies still showing earlier free offers are historical, not proof of current availability. Page/catalog absence does not establish permanent model retirement. No exact Beam/Crouton end date or Laguna retirement day was verified; no claims are made about other providers.
